levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن بزيع
عبد الله بن محمد بن عبد الرحمن

notes: «وهو ابن زريع» is an editor gloss between dashes: left out
The two branches meet at خالد (Khalid al-Hadhdha): each names him, the first as the teacher of يزيد, the second as the teacher of شعبة; the tail starts after him
The Companion شداد بن أوس is the last link
